notes.title: 1.5.1 Patch - Store Fixed, Physics update, Bomb go Boom
notes.notes:
Hey Cogheads,

We are very sorry for the issue with the new minimart, but it has been fixed. Plus we continued to hear complaints about the physics even though we are a big fan of them now, so we increase the physics material friction to made them a bit more realistic and have less cogs standing upright. Plus to adjust to the new heavier physics we've increase the explosion from the bomb!

Changlog:
[list]
[*]Fixed buying in the Minimart
[*]Made Normal Cogs heavier
[*]Increased Friction of all objects
[*]Made Bomb explosion bigger
[/list]

Happy Cogging,
Spacefudge

notes.title: ⚙️ HUGE Endless Replayability Update ⚙️
notes.notes:
Hi Cogheads,

We have been listening to the feedback from the community and players for the gamefeel, function, replayability. And we wanted to bring a big new update for the Endless Replayability Steam fest to celebrate. 

Here is a summary of the update:
[list]
[*] New Token system - reset and crit tokens allow the player to choose when to reset their cog trough or time a critical hit with a big drop of cogs
[*] New Heavier, more realistic, bouncie Physics - Cogs feel more like coins, fall over easier, more satisfying
[*] New Physics Impact SFX - with new added coin impact sounds the coin pusher never felt more real!
[*] New Minimart - After every battle you get a small random shop and chance to heal up
[*] New Blacksmith - Replaced old shop journey nodes with Blacksmith shop where you can choose from all the cogs and upgrade your cogs
[*] Added Combo Meter!
[*] Fixed cogs falling through trough bug

[/list]

Hope you all enjoy! please be sure to leave a review or give us more [url=https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUFFLUhqbE1kYmtIS1RSX0tXVUQzRDJfX1RSVEVLc3JJQXxBQ3Jtc0traHF4M3JINDg1ZGdnQmNRZkQ3VmwxR3hJS2pJSTJlczc5WmtZME9iektBYXF3ZzZ3VlF2VFU0N3MydVkyMzJfTEhFUlJyU29kalpSemtQeENhVTlyUE1mamZiSVYxVnZvRFFOejVUZkNJaUxQYVlIcw&q=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F6ZTjfKuB5R&v=S1gsEr5Rqvw]feedback on the discord[/url]

Happy Cogging,
Spacefudge

notes.title: NEW PHYSICS & ACHIEVEMENT!!
notes.notes:
Hi CogHeads, 

We've heard some of the community's feedback and decided to improve the Clockwork Owl Physics to be less floaty and more realistic, but bouncie, to give more weight to the cogs like real arcade coin pushers. 

We also saw some of you dissappointed the old demo achievement was impossible to unlock, so we've added a new one for FULL 100% COGPLETION!

Hope you all enjoy, let us know if you have any more feedback!

Best,
Spacefudge

notes.title: Clockwork Owl - Releasing August 3rd
notes.notes:
[h2]WATCH NEW GAME TRAILER
[/h2]
[previewyoutube=TCW1Lo5mR0I;full][/previewyoutube]
RELEASE TRAILER Shows off most everything new!

[h2]WHAT'S NEW[/h2]
We are so very excited about this new contentful version of Clockwork Owl! The Turn-based change instantly made the game 10x the fun.. with real skill involved now. The new Roguelike journey map, and random chest encounters make the game a whole different experience every time you play. There is an all new library of jazzy lofi music (10 tracks) that really set the moOOOoood. The new boss fights, new cogs, new enemies and worlds add a whole lot more of a challenge and hours of fun.


[h2]PLAY THE BETA
[/h2]

If you'd like to play the new beta of the game join the discord before August 3rd and Wishlist the game and we will provide you with a beta key: [url=https://discord.gg/AbUjb5ZWbU]JOIN DISCORD[/url]


[h2]NEW WORLDS
[/h2]
The new worlds are a whole different ball game.. 

After beating the first boss you will be transported to Japan in a different time period, where you will need next level finesse to take on all new enemies and a boss fight. All with a backing of some new immersive jazzy lofi music.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132566/5f44d27d187d43f2988e76814042dd413d32418e.png[/img]


After taking down Japan's boss you will be transported even further back in time to Ancient Eygpt where a larger than life Sphinx is under construction. You better have mastered cog pushing by then because this world is a real challenge with a mighty king as a finale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43132566/1e88d74b19b0ba3cf18487a06e8395cf8f19515d.png[/img]
